observations: Large black and grey printer wrapped in clear plastic film.
A promotional sticker on the front shows an HP logo and text 'Color LaserJet Enterprise CP4525'.
The printer is sitting on a wooden stand outdoors on a paved surface.
The plastic wrap obscures the front panel, control buttons, and the paper output area.
No toner cartridges or power cables are visible.

claims.claim: HP Color LaserJet Enterprise CP4525 Printer series

claims.evidence: Requires a video of the printer running a print test.
Requires a video of the printer running a print test.

claims.claim: Low page count, under 20,000 copies. New drum and toner just fitted, no paper jam.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The printer may not power on or may have internal mechanical faults.
risks.proof: A video showing the printer powering on and completing a self-test.

risks.risk: The toner cartridge may be empty or the drum may be near the end of its life.
risks.proof: A photo of the printer's status screen showing the remaining toner and drum life.
risks.if_unproven: as needing a new toner cartridge

risks.risk: The plastic wrap may conceal significant surface scratches or dust on the casing.
risks.proof: Clear photos of the front, top, and sides of the printer without the wrap.

proof_requests: Video of the printer powering on and printing a test page.
Photo of the printer's status screen showing toner and drum levels.
Clear photos of the printer without the plastic wrap to check for physical damage.
response.reason: The model is clearly identified from the sticker in photo 0, so it can be priced at its worst case as a non-working unit in need of a new toner cartridge.
